name: ocr-beans
description: OCR Beans — extrator de texto de processos judiciais brasileiros (PDF e imagem). Motor PyMuPDF + Tesseract 100% offline: detecta fontes corrompidas de tribunais (TJSP/TRF/STJ) e aplica OCR automaticamente. Verificado contra o OCRBeans.exe original: 475/475 páginas idênticas.

description_i18n.en: OCR Beans — text extractor for Brazilian court documents (PDF and images). PyMuPDF + Tesseract engine, 100% offline: detects corrupted court fonts and applies OCR automatically. Verified against the original OCRBeans.exe: 475/475 identical pages.
description_i18n.zh-CN: OCR Beans — 巴西司法文书文本提取工具（PDF 与图像）。PyMuPDF + Tesseract 引擎，完全离线：自动检测法院文档的损坏字体并执行 OCR。已对照原版 OCRBeans.exe 验证：475/475 页结果一致。
